full_text:
Article 7 (Working-Level Consultative Councils)
(1) A council may establish a working-level consultative council whose members are directors in charge of overall planning affairs at the relevant local governments and bureau directors or division heads responsible for affairs relating to the matters for consultation. <Amended on December 8, 1994; and April 2, 2026.>
(2) A working-level consultative council shall examine in advance matters to be consulted on by the council and submit a written opinion on its examination to the council.
